dish.title: Persian Lamb Koobideh Kebabs with Saffron Rice and Grilled Tomatoes
dish.description: Ground lamb kneaded with grated onion, turmeric, and black pepper, shaped onto flat skewers, and grilled until juicy and charred. Served on fluffy saffron basmati with a pat of butter, blistered grilled tomatoes, sumac, raw onion, and herbs.

recipe_version.title: Persian Lamb Koobideh Kebabs with Saffron Rice and Grilled Tomatoes
recipe_version.description: Ground lamb kneaded with grated onion, turmeric, and black pepper, shaped onto flat skewers, and grilled until juicy and charred. Served on fluffy saffron basmati with a pat of butter, blistered grilled tomatoes, sumac, raw onion, and herbs.

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.preparation: finely grated and squeezed dry in a towel

ingredients.name: fresh mint and basil
ingredients.display_name: loosely packed fresh mint and basil sprigs

steps.title: Make the kebab mixture
steps.body: Grate the onion, squeeze it very dry in a towel, and knead it with the lamb, turmeric, pepper, and 2 tsp salt for 3 minutes until tacky. Cover and refrigerate. Rinse the rice until clear. Grind the saffron with a pinch of salt and bloom it in 3 tbsp hot water. Slice the red onion and wash the herbs.

steps.title: Par-boil the rice
steps.body: Bring 12 cups water and 2 1/2 tsp salt to a rolling boil in a 6-quart pot. Add the rice and boil until the grains are tender outside with a firm core, about 6 minutes. Drain in a strainer.

steps.title: Chill
steps.body: The kebab mixture firms in the refrigerator while the rice par-boils (overlap stated).

steps.title: Steam the rice
steps.body: Wipe the pot, add the neutral oil, and spoon the rice back in loosely in a mound. Poke 3 holes with a spoon handle, cover the lid with a towel, and steam over low until the grains are tender, about 22 minutes. This runs inside steps 5 and 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Preheat the grill and shape the kebabs
steps.body: Preheat the grill on high, lid closed, for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, divide the lamb into 8 portions and squeeze each onto a flat skewer into a long, even kebab about 1 inch wide, pinching ridges along it with your fingers.

steps.title: Grill
steps.body: Clean and oil the grate. Grill the tomatoes whole, turning, until blistered; after 4 minutes, lay the kebabs across the grate beside them and grill, turning every 1 to 2 minutes, until charred at the ridges and 160 F, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish the rice
steps.body: Melt the butter into the 3 tbsp saffron water. Scoop 1 cup of rice into it, toss until golden, and fluff the rest.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spread white rice on a platter, top with the saffron rice, slide the kebabs off the skewers alongside, and add the tomatoes. Sprinkle the kebabs and rice with sumac and serve with the red onion and herbs.

equipment: 8 flat metal skewers, 3/4 to 1 inch wide
